data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘Rubens’ meaning reddish-brown. Roanna is a beautiful name for a little girl, evoking images of auburn hair and rich, earthy tones. It was a popular name in ancient Rome, and is still cherished today for its timeless elegance and classic charm. The name Roanna carries the meaning “Reddish-brown” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Roanna usually hope their child will grow to embody reddish-brown and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Ροάνα
in_greek.meaning: Το φως και η αγάπη του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ροάνα προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'ρόη' και 'άνα', που σημαίνουν 'Το φως και η αγάπη του Θεού'. Στην αρχαία Εκκλησία, το όνομα αυτό συσχετιζόταν με την έννοια του θείου φωτός και της αγάπης.

in_latin.name: Roanna
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Roanna derivatur ex vocibus Latinis 'lux' et 'amor', quae significant 'Lumen et amor Dei'. In primitiva Ecclesia, nomen hoc referretur ad notionem divini luminis et amoris.
